Don't really know why I did this, but... here it is. Would love to hear you guys' thoughts on it, for I've probably made some mistakes in balancing.

Neutral attack- Control Yourself: Two light lower slaps before a slow, haymaker-like punch.

Forward tilt- Ham: Whips a slab of ham. One of Jontron's few moves that only hits once, the attack has noteworthy damage and knockback, especially when sweetspotted on the tip.

Up tilt- Christmas Nuts: Holds a pan over his head, which pops up three fire damaging nuts. Knockback is focused on the third strike.

Down tilt- Actual Noise: Plays a Commodore 64 cassette, which plays loud noises. Hits twice. Causes electric damage, with longer than average stun-time.

Dash attack- Rockington Roll- Rolls a small rock forward. Hits 3 times. Hitbox is focussed only on the rock, rendering airborne opponents immune.

Forward smash- ECH!: Violently coughs forward. Medium damage with weak knockback, but makes up with large hitbox, minimal startup, and flower effect.

Up smash- Rug Sword/Ten: Pulls up a sword and thrusts it in the air. Has an easily punishable cool down, but the tip of the sword damages a surprising amount while held, even excluding the opening sweetspot. Occasionally the move will be replace with scoreboard with the number “10”, an attack with higher knockback, but a much smaller hitbox and a fixed damage at 10%. Strangely enough, both moves are counted as “slash damage”.

Down smash- DoubleHack: Summons two computers beside him and creates fast ascending code. Hits 3 times for electric damage. Spread far enough to trap opponents further away, but misses at close range. Knockback deals straight up.

Neutral aerial- Foodfight: Pops a bag of confetti, dealing 3 weak hits around him.

Forward aerial- Strap In!: Puts on a helmet and fires three short-ranged laser shots, one slightly upwards, one forwards, and one slightly downwards. Very weak with little knockback.

Back aerial- Candy Corn Catastrophe: Vomits out candy corn behind him for a total of 4 weak attacks.

Up aerial- Hangers: Twirls a clothes hangar over his head. Hits 3 times.

Down aerial- Fool Me Once: Slams a hammer down. Possibly one of JonTron’s most dangerous moves, as along with its power, it generates little startup, even if its cool down is high. The move does have a rather debilitating Achilles Heel: after it is used three times in a match, the hammer shatters, regardless if the previous times hit opponents. JonTron’s down aerial is subsequently replaced with a chair which alongside having horrible lag on both ends deals pitiful damage and knockback. This chair lasts for the rest of the match, even if JonTron is KO’ed. Opponents hit by the shattering strike of the hammer will gain X1.5 times the damage, but no knockback.

Pummel- The Only Way it Will Work: Puts the opponents in a vice.

Forward throw- Slaps: Timidly slaps the opponent’s wrist, sending them flying.

Back throw- Game Toss: Slowly twirls around the opponent before flicking them, ala Mario. The swings can damage others.

Up throw- Florida: Blows fire at the opponent. Lousy knockback, but might hit others.

Down throw- Matt Smith: Throws opponent down before stabbing with a pair of scissors.

Neutral special- Jacques Beam: Jacques fires a laser beam from his eyes. The longer the special button is held, the stronger the attack is, but the shorter its range: a fully charged beam shoots only a little further than ECH!, while only tapping the special button shoots a beam around half the length of Final Destination.

Side special- Jacques Mirror: Jacques pulls out a handheld mirror that reflects projectiles and attacks. Jon is propelled slightly forward from the move.

Up special- Jacques Carry: Jacques flies JonTron upwards. Although the move itself deals no damage, pressing the special button again causes Jacques to fire a laser beam at the cost of Jon’s flight. Pressing down will cancel the move. JonTron does not go helpless from this move.

Down special- Jacques Target: Jacques applies a reticle on a random near opponent. The move has a lengthy startup, taking about half a second for Jacques to acquire a target. Although lacking damage on its own, the move paralyzes the targeted opponent and briefly gives JonTron X1.25 damage and X.90 knockback against them (the reduced knockback can be a blessing in disguise for JonTron’s multiple hitting moveset). Opponents glow a slight red sheen when hit, and like most status effects, are inflicted by the debuff longer the more damage they have, while the debuff’s length at 0% damage is seven seconds. The move will fail if no opponents are in range or an opponent is already under its effect; attempting to use the move in these cases will paralyze JonTron briefly and cause 5% recoil damage. The move can be cancelled, however, simply by releasing the special before the move is enacted, with minimal cool down.

Final Smash- To the Moon, Though: Grabs an opponent and shoots up into the sky, where the blastzone is replaced by a damaging ceiling of fire. The held opponent quickly generates damage. After about 6 seconds, JonTron rockets downward, causing a massive meteor effect on the grabbed opponent and a small blast radius on anyone near. More than one opponent can be caught, although they take no damage from JonTron’s ascent or descent. The move fails if JonTron misses his grab.
